description: PERM Tracker's own record: every estimate it gives with how its check came out, the nightly PERM backtest on real decisions, and the daily sample of recorded dates graded as DOL decides them. Quote a figure with its basis. Example: {}.
name: get_accuracy

asOf.description: The date the data is true for, YYYY-MM-DD, when one applies.

anyOf.description: How close PERM Tracker's estimates land, graded against what DOL and the State Department did.

basis.description: The cases it was checked on, with their days.

estimate.description: What's estimated, as a reader would ask it.

result.description: How the check came out, in short.

checks.description: Every estimate the site gives, with how its own check came out, as the scorecard prints it. Null when the checks couldn't be read.

anyOf.description: One program's daily sample of predictions, graded as DOL decides.

biasDays.description: The median of decision minus prediction: above 0 means decisions came later than predicted.

graded.description: Of those, graded against a decision.

inRangeShare.description: The share of graded predictions decided inside the range given, 0 to 1.

missAtLeastDays.description: The typical miss counting each overdue case at the days it's already late: a floor.

overdue.description: Predictions past their day and still waiting.

anyOf.description: The first day a prediction was recorded, as YYYY-MM-DD.

typicalMissDays.description: The median days between the predicted day and the decision.

within14Share.description: The share decided within 14 days of the predicted day, 0 to 1.

anyOf.description: One program's daily sample of predictions, graded as DOL decides.

biasDays.description: The median of decision minus prediction: above 0 means decisions came later than predicted.

graded.description: Of those, graded against a decision.

inRangeShare.description: The share of graded predictions decided inside the range given, 0 to 1.

missAtLeastDays.description: The typical miss counting each overdue case at the days it's already late: a floor.

overdue.description: Predictions past their day and still waiting.

anyOf.description: The first day a prediction was recorded, as YYYY-MM-DD.

typicalMissDays.description: The median days between the predicted day and the decision.

within14Share.description: The share decided within 14 days of the predicted day, 0 to 1.

dailySample.description: The dates recorded each day for a random sample of pending cases, graded as DOL decides them.

decided.description: PERM cases DOL decided in it.

decidedByEndRight.description: The share of calls about the window (decided by the end, or not yet) that were right, 0 to 1.

from.description: The first day of the backtest, as YYYY-MM-DD.

typicalMissDays.description: The median days between each case's date and its decision.

within7Share.description: The share decided within a week of their date, 0 to 1.

permBacktest.description: The nightly PERM backtest: real decisions, each dated as the line stood on the first day.

unreadable.description: The parts of this answer that couldn't be read just now, by field name. Each is null in this answer. An empty list means every part was read.

anyOf.description: No such record. Say so; don't retry the same call.

message.description: What wasn't found and what to try, in a sentence.

data.description: The answer, or found: false when no record matched.

page.description: The page on permtracker.app that shows the same thing. Cite it.

title: Get the estimates' own record
